title: Exact Authoritative Consumer Migration

decision_record.malformed_canonical_command: reject at COMMAND_ADMISSION with stable code and path
decision_record.support_root_time_binding: projected exact pre-state, never evaluated post-state
decision_record.v5_promotion: forbidden until semantic coverage, migration, verifier, runtime, and cross-language evidence close
decision_record.authority_boundary: the closed typed admission combinator is the sole authority admission mechanism
decision_record.admitted_graph_rule: the evaluator admits the command graph once and passes the same exact object identities to private already-admitted sinks
decision_record.private_sink_rule: private already-admitted sinks are capability-restricted by structural import checks and cannot be imported by arbitrary modules

source_changes.summary: The candidate evaluator admits the exact settlement and intent tuple once, reports stable StateAdmissionError details at COMMAND_ADMISSION, and passes the same returned exact object graph to nonce, settlement, fee, and support consumers.

The public nonce wrapper remains independently safe and re-admits input. The evaluator uses a private already-admitted sink that consumes the exact tuple without a second admission. The legacy nonce implementation remains differential-only.

The public settlement wrapper remains independently safe. The evaluator passes the same admitted settlement and intent identities to a private settlement sink and to fee computation, eliminating reconstruction and parallel command graphs.

Mounted support-root v4 retains its prior domain and bytes. Exact support-root v5 is separate, unmounted, and includes every route leg pool plus sender input and actual recipient output balance cells.
Candidate evidence and the shadow receipt bind support_root_version=5 for the unmounted exact profile. The v5 support root is derived from the same admitted pre-state used by evaluation.

The exact-consumers profile covers evaluator, nonce, route, replay, support-root, and shadow surfaces. It rejects raw aliases, raw companions, wrong call shapes, ignored or rebound sink results, re-admission in private sinks, post-state support roots, direct or reflective private-sink capture, private module-object capture, and unauthorized imports.
The exact-consumers structural profile is included in the critical quality gate.

exact_unmounted_v5.current_scope: route-complete correction plus exact owned admission

support_root_profiles.parity_claim: No v4/v5 parity is claimed. Their divergence is intentional and version-bound.

open_m5_prerequisites: Audit and define a complete v5 support footprint for every mounted spot intent, including actual recipients, all written balance cells, all pool cells, LP ownership and duration metadata, protocol-fee recipients when active, nonces, configuration, and execution context.

Either complete the v5 support-root migration with new version, profile, schema, verifier, adapter, proof-guest, golden-vector, replay, and cross-language evidence, or leave the M4 candidate unmounted.
Produce and verify one immutable three-way decision and atomic commit-bundle contract before changing mounted authority.
nonclaims: M4 does not mount the exact evaluator as production authority.
M4 does not claim support-root v5 is complete for every spot intent.
M4 does not claim v4 and v5 support roots are equivalent.
M4 does not prove datastore linearizability, crash recovery, external exactly-once delivery, or idempotent destination behavior.
M4 does not establish Python, Rust, Tau, Lean, proof-guest, or accelerated-runtime equivalence.
The unavailable ESSO, Mathlib, and Tau lanes prevent a full formal or release claim.
